subject: Error in FUN: object 'input' not found

messages.author: 51c0523df0fe5e0c
messages.subject: Error in FUN: object 'input' not found
parts:
library(ROracle)
drv <- dbDriver("Oracle")
host <- "oracle.vittl.it.bond.edu.au"
port <- "1521"
sid <- "inft320" 
connect.string <- paste(
"(DESCRIPTION=",
"(ADDRESS=(PROTOCOL=tcp)(HOST=", host, ")(PORT=", port, "))",
"(CONNECT_DATA=(SID=", sid, ")))", sep = "")

con <- dbConnect(drv, username = "A13457712", password = "A13457712",
             dbname = connect.string)


rs <- dbSendQuery(con, "select * from brucedba.BankMarketing")


data <- fetch(rs)       
head(data)
data <- data[-11]


#Turn 
col.factor <- c(2:10, 14, 20)
col.numeric <- c(1, 11:13, 15:19)
data[col.numeric] <- lapply(data[col.numeric], as.numeric)
data[col.factor] <- lapply(data[col.factor], as.factor)

I can't access the input id from my shiny server. I want to create a lapply function that uses the input ids' strings and creates a data frame off them. I'd then like to make a prediction on that data frame and print it.

library(shiny)

shinyServer( function(input, output) { 
output$ct <- renderPlot ({

library(party)
ct = ctree(Y~., data = data, 
controls=ctree_control(maxdepth=input$maxdepth))
plot(ct, main="Classification Tree for IRIS Dataset produced by party 
package") 
})

library(dplyr)
output$person <- renderPrint( 
person <- lapply(1:19, function(i){input[[paste0(names(data)[i])]]}),
print(person)
) 
})
library(shiny)  


shinyUI( fluidPage(


titlePanel("Decision Tree") ,

sidebarPanel (
verbatimTextOutput('person'),
lapply(c(2:10,14), function(i){
selectInput( paste0(names(data)[i]), label = h5(paste0(names(data)[i])),
choices = levels(data[,names(data)[i]]))
}),
lapply(c(1, 11:13, 15:19), function(i){
numericInput(paste0(names(data)[i]), label = h5(paste0(names(data)[i])), 
value = median(data[,names(data)[i]]), 
min = min(data[,names(data)[i]]), max = max(data[,names(data)[i]]))
})),

mainPanel(
sliderInput("maxdepth", label = h3("Max Depth"), min = 1, max = 10, value = 
2),
plotOutput("ct", width= 1000 , height=500 )
)
)
)

messages.subject: Re: Error in FUN: object 'input' not found
parts: I'm not sure if this is the root of your problem or not, but it looks like your renderPrint is missing { }, so it's like you're passing two arguments to renderPrint instead of one code block.
